requirements.name: Academic requirements assessment
requirements.detail: PEO reviews your degree; may assign technical exams if the program isn't recognized.

requirements.name: Professional Practice Exam (PPE)
requirements.detail: Law and ethics exam required of all applicants.

requirements.name: 48 months engineering experience
requirements.detail: Acceptable engineering work experience; ~12 months in a Canadian jurisdiction is preferred.

requirements.name: P.Eng. licence application
requirements.detail: Final application once academics, PPE and experience are satisfied.

notes: Title 'engineer' is protected in Ontario; practice requires the P.Eng. licence.
